facebook.long_form:
Oklahoma softball's fall continues tomorrow night — and if you missed the Battle Series opener at Love's Field, now is your chance to make up for it.

Game 3 goes Tuesday, October 14 at 6:30 PM CT. Tickets are just $10.88 GA at Love's Field, and the game streams on 1Oklahoma.com for those who can't make it in person.

The opener on September 30 drew a sold-out crowd — in October, for a fall exhibition. Patty Gasso got emotional talking about it afterward, because that's how much this team already means to Sooner Nation. And they haven't played a real game yet.

Here's what to watch:
🔹 **Kendall Wells** — 39 home runs in 2026, NFCA Freshman of the Year. The most dangerous bat in college softball.
🔹 **Jayda Kavan** — Won the WCWS Most Outstanding Player award TWICE. At OU now. Let that sink in.
🔹 **Jordan Cruz + Rylee Ludlow** — Two of the most experienced bats in the lineup.
🔹 **Alex Berzon** — 2.02 ERA, 52 wins, 416 strikeouts. The best pitcher in the country is back on the mound.

These fall games are your preview of what the 2027 season will look like. Don't miss tomorrow night.

📍 Love's Field | 🕢 6:30 PM CT | 🎟️ $10.88 GA | 💻 1Oklahoma.com

stories.title: Texas vs. Texas State — Game Night at McCombs Field
stories.angle: Texas softball hosts Texas State tonight at 6 PM CT at McCombs Field — free admission. The Longhorns opened fall 28-1 over Murray State. The real test: first public look at Isa Torres (.530 BA, 16 HR as FSU transfer) and Teagan Kavan (2x WCWS MOP) working together. Second of six fall games; Nov. 6 at Texas A&M is the season-defining date.

facebook.long_form:
Two of the most talked-about names in college softball share a dugout for the first time tonight.

Isa Torres — transferred from Florida State, slashed .530/.609/.980 with 16 home runs and 56 RBIs. A Player of the Year candidate who chose Texas for a reason.

Teagan Kavan — won the WCWS Most Outstanding Player award *twice*. Two-time champion. Brought her rings and her intensity to Austin this fall.

Tonight, they take the field together at McCombs Field when Texas hosts Texas State at 6 PM CT. Free admission.

The Longhorns already beat Murray State 28-1 in the fall opener. Tonight is about polish, preparation, and showing what this roster can really do when it matters.

November 6 at Texas A&M is circled on everyone's calendar. But tonight is the first real look.

📍 McCombs Field, Austin | 🕕 6 PM CT | 🎟️ Free admission

stories.title: Tennessee 2027 Staff Takes Shape — Earleywine Joins After Coaching Departures
stories.angle: Tennessee hired Ehren Earleywine as associate head coach/hitting coach in June 2026 — a major get after Craig Snider and Stephanie Sanders departed to become co-head coaches at Auburn. Earleywine brings 20+ years of experience, most recently as associate head coach at Texas during their 2026 NCAA championship run. Karen Weekly's staff is now set for the 2027 season.

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
Karen Weekly answered the coaching staff question.

Ehren Earleywine is in — associate head coach from Texas, where he helped develop the 2026 national champions.

The Lady Vols' 2027 coaching staff is set. #VolSoftball #Softball

facebook.long_form:
Karen Weekly finally has her coaching staff in place for the 2027 season — and she made a significant hire.

After Craig Snider and Stephanie Sanders departed for Auburn (where they're now co-head coaches), Weekly needed to rebuild a staff that could support a program coming off back-to-back top-10 finishes.

Her answer: **Ehren Earleywine**, hired in June as associate head coach and hitting coach.

Earleywine brings more than two decades of experience, including a 14-year stretch as a head coach and most recently as associate head coach at Texas — where he helped develop the hitting approach that powered the 2026 NCAA champion Longhorns.

That experience matters. Tennessee returns 9 starters for 2027, including senior infielder Karley Shelton (transferred in from South Carolina). The Lady Vols have the talent. Earleywine has the blueprint for making it click offensively.

The Lady Vols have been building quietly this fall. Their 2027 staff is now set. Watch out for Rocky Top.

stories.title: Robot Umpires Coming to Softball — ABS Challenge System Approved for 2027
stories.angle: The NCAA approved an Automated Ball-Strike (ABS) challenge system for all NCAA levels in 2027 — baseball already confirmed; softball is moving to an experimental basis. The Sun Belt Conference is expanding its Trackman partnership for both sports. Teams can challenge home-plate calls when tech is installed. It's the biggest rules evolution for the sport since the mercy rule.

facebook.long_form:
The biggest rules change coming to NCAA softball since the mercy rule — and it's happening in 2027.

The NCAA has approved an Automated Ball-Strike (ABS) challenge system for all NCAA levels starting next season. The system is confirmed for baseball and moving to softball on an experimental basis. The Sun Belt Conference is already in, announcing an expanded partnership with Trackman to bring ball-strike technology to their parks.

Here's how it works: Teams can challenge certain ball-strike calls by the home-plate umpire when the appropriate tracking technology is installed. If the challenge succeeds, the call gets overturned. If it fails, you lose a challenge.

At the SEC's 2026 baseball tournament, 105 calls were challenged — and about 56 percent were overturned. That's more than half of challenged calls reversed by technology.

What does this mean for softball?

✅ The check-swing call — one of the sport's most disputed — becomes challengeable.
✅ Close pitches on the black get objective review.
✅ The game's integrity improves.

⚠️ Not every park will have it immediately — installation costs are a barrier.
⚠️ Managing challenge strategy mid-game adds another decision layer for coaches.

This is the future of the sport arriving in real time. What do you think — is this good for softball?
facebook.image_caption: Robot umpires are coming to NCAA softball in 2027. The ABS challenge system is approved. The check-swing debate just got a ticking clock. ⏰

stories.title: 2028 Contact Period Opens Next Week — Recruiting Rush on the Horizon
stories.angle: The October 17-18 contact period for 2028 recruits opens in four days. Oklahoma already has 5 commits (including Grace Tonga, OF). Florida has No. 2 overall Kylie Holden plus Brooklyn Evans (C). With 137+ portal entries tracked and the contact window approaching, expect a wave of high school commits this weekend through next week.

facebook.long_form:
The next major recruiting moment in college softball is just four days away.

The 2028 contact period opens October 17-18 — the first window where coaches can have direct, official contact with prospective recruits from the Class of 2028. Expect a wave of commitments from high school programs over the next two weeks.

Here's who's already ahead:

**Oklahoma (5 commits):**
The Sooners added outfielder Grace Tonga on Sept. 22 as their fifth 2028 commit. OU has been aggressive in locking up the class early, and with Love's Field selling out fall exhibitions, those recruits know what they're getting into.

**Florida (2 key commits):**
The Gators landed No. 2 overall 2028 prospect Kylie Holden (five-star MI) earlier this fall, then added catcher Brooklyn Evans. With 6 of 9 starters returning for 2027, Tim Walton can sell continuity AND opportunity.

What to watch this week:
• Which programs are "winners" of the contact weekend — measured by commit announcements Oct. 18-21
• Whether OU, Alabama, Texas, and UCLA add to already strong early classes
• Where five-star pitchers land — pitching depth defines 2028 class value

The 2028 class is already taking shape. When the contact window opens, it accelerates fast.
